abstract: Maintains field life-support infrastructure records and camp personnel water demand figures
system_message:
You are the Camp logistics lead (LOG), responsible for maintaining field life-support infrastructure records, camp personnel water demand figures, and generator fuel logistics for field observatory deployments.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains field life-support infrastructure records and camp personnel water demand figures（BASE）
information_points.content:
LOG-BASE-VNE：For the Salar de Tara Caldera Camp, the camp life-support allocation audit records a base camp personnel water demand of 450 L/d for the full operational crew of researchers and logistics technicians.
LOG-BASE-3GT：For the Cerro Pabellon High Plateau Setup, the camp life-support allocation audit indicates that the base camp personnel water demand across the full operational crew of researchers and logistics technicians is 520 L/d.
LOG-BASE-LOM：According to the camp life-support allocation audit for the Paso Jama Ridge Installation, the base camp personnel water demand for the full operational crew of researchers and logistics technicians is 450 L/d.

information_points.title: Generator fuel logistics（FUEL）
information_points.content:
LOG-FUEL-7L8：According to the site fuel log for the Salar de Tara Caldera Camp, the base camp auxiliary power generator depot maintains a monthly diesel reserve volume of 1,800 L.
LOG-FUEL-8LF：For the Cerro Pabellon High Plateau Setup, the site fuel log records a monthly diesel reserve volume of 1,500 L held at the base camp auxiliary power generator depot.
LOG-FUEL-DIF：At the Paso Jama Ridge Installation, the monthly diesel reserve volume stored at the base camp auxiliary power generator depot is 1,200 L according to the site fuel log.
